svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Where each model is strong, and where it breaks
Department score, 0-100. The SHAPE matters more than the height: a flat-but-lower line is a safer hire than a spiky one.
